return(function(feed,mu,pnlu,kt,vvi)for cva=0,255 do feed[mu(cva,0)]=mu(cva)end function kt(cva,bi,rc,nlp)bi[mu(rc,nlp)]=cva rc=rc+1 if rc>255 then rc=0 nlp=nlp+1 if nlp>255 then bi={}nlp=1 end end return bi,rc,nlp end vvi=({([==[]==]):gsub('%gw',''):gsub('%x%x',function(cva)return mu(tonumber(cva,16))end)})[1]local cva,bi,rc,nlp,al,dll,duxp=#vvi,{},0,1,{},1,pnlu(vvi,1,2)al[dll]=feed[duxp]or bi[duxp]dll=dll+1 for nngn=3,cva,2 do local pia,kr=pnlu(vvi,nngn,nngn+1),feed[duxp]or bi[duxp]local hk=feed[pia]or bi[pia]if hk then al[dll]=hk dll=dll+1 bi,rc,nlp=kt(kr..pnlu(hk,1,1),bi,rc,nlp)else local becl=kr..pnlu(kr,1,1)al[dll]=becl dll=dll+1 bi,rc,nlp=kt(becl,bi,rc,nlp)end duxp=pia end local gw,luo=loadstring(table.concat(al))if not gw then error('DShub load failed: '..tostring(luo),0)end pcall(setfenv,gw,getfenv(1))return gw end)({},string.char,string.sub)(...)
